name: pawper-dev
description: Read-only MCP card advertising the discoverable surface of pawper.dev. The site is a static portfolio; in lieu of a live MCP server, this card points agents at the public RSS feeds and content URLs that already act as machine-readable endpoints.

tools.name: list_projects_feed
tools.description: Fetch the full RSS feed of portfolio projects.

tools.name: list_logs_feed
tools.description: Fetch the full RSS feed of long-form logs.

tools.name: list_activity_feed
tools.description: Fetch the cross-portfolio commit activity feed.
